self-abandoned.translation:
a. 自暴自弃的, 放纵的
[法] 自暴自弃, 放肆的, 为所欲为的

self-abandonment.translation: n. 自暴自弃, 丧失自制

self-abasement.definition: n voluntary self-punishment in order to atone for some wrongdoing

self-abnegating.translation: a. 自我克制的, 克己的；自我牺牲的

self-abnegation.definition: n renunciation of your own interests in favor of the interests of others
self-abnegation.translation: n. 自我牺牲, 克己

self-absorbed.definition: s. absorbed in your own interests or thoughts etc

self-absorption.definition: n. preoccupation with yourself to the exclusion of everything else
self-absorption.translation:
n. 自我专注, 自吸收
[医] 自吸收; 自我专注

self-abuse.definition: n manual stimulation of your own genital organ for sexual pleasure
self-abuse.translation:
n. 自责, 手淫
[医] 自渎, 手淫

self-access.translation: a. 自主学习的（由学生自选材料并自学）

self-accusation.definition: n. an admission that you have failed to do or be something you know you should do or be
self-accusation.translation:
n. 自我责备, 自责
[法] 自责, 自首

self-acknowledged.translation: adj. 自我承认的; 自我供认的

self-acting.definition: s. designed to activate or move or regulate itself

self-activating.definition: s designed to activate or move or regulate itself

self-actualized.translation:
adj. 自我实践的; 自我实现的
v. 自我实现（self-actualize的过去式和过去分词）

self-addressed.translation: a. 写明发信人姓名地址的, 自言自语的

self-adhesive.translation: a. 自动附着的, 自粘的

self-adhesive paper.translation: [化] 自粘纸; 不干胶纸

self-adhesives.translation: (self-adhesive 的复数) adj. 自动附着的, 自粘的

self-adjusting.definition:
a. Capable of assuming a desired position or condition
   with relation to other parts, under varying circumstances, without
   requiring to be adjusted by hand; -- said of a piece in machinery.
self-adjusting.translation:
a. 自动调节的
[化] 自动调整

self-administered.translation: [法] 自治的, 自己管理的

self-administrations.translation: (self-administration 的复数)  [医]自我给药, 自己给药

self-affected.translation: a. 自负的, 顾影自怜的

self-aggrandizement.definition: n. an act undertaken to increase your own power and influence or to draw attention to your own importance

self-aggrandizing.definition:
a of or relating to or characteristic of self-aggrandizement
s exhibiting self-importance
self-aggrandizing.translation: a. 自我扩张的；谋求自我扩张的

self-analysis.definition:
n a penetrating examination of your own beliefs and motives
n the application of psychotherapeutic principles to the analysis of your own personality

self-analytical.translation: a. 【心理学】自我分析的[亦作 self-analytic]

self-annihilation.definition: n. the act of killing yourself
self-annihilation.translation: n. （在对神默祷中的）自我消灭

self-appointed.definition: s. designated or chosen by yourself

self-asserting.translation: a. 自作主张的; 自信的；专横的; 自我断言的

self-assertion.definition:
n. the act of putting forth your own opinions in a boastful or inconsiderate manner that implies you feel superior to others
n. the act of asserting yourself in an aggressive manner
self-assertion.translation:
n. 自作主张
[法] 一意孤行, 坚持自己的权利

self-assertive.definition:
a aggressively self-assured
s offensively self-assertive
self-assertive.translation: a. 自作主张的, 孤行专断的

self-assertiveness.definition: n. aggressive self-assurance; given to making bold assertions
self-assertiveness.translation: [医]自作主张, 专断, 过分自信

self-assumed.definition: a. Assumed by one's own act, or without authority.
self-assumed.translation: a. 自称的, 僭越的, 自许的

self-assumption.translation: n. 自负, 自大, 自命不凡

self-assurance.definition: n freedom from doubt; belief in yourself and your abilities

self-assured.definition: s. showing poise and confidence in your own worth

self-aware.definition: s aware of yourself as an individual or of your own being and actions and thoughts
self-aware.translation: a. 自知的, 自我意识的

self-awareness.definition: n. awareness of your own individuality
